podcast.title: Diversity at Austin City Limits Festival (2023)
podcast.body: Shania Twain performed at the Austin City Limits Music Festival in 2023, representing the festival's broad appeal across genres, from contemporary country to rock and hip-hop. "For example, in 2023, they had acts that were ranging at their festival from the food fighters to Kendrick Lamar to Shenaya Twain to Tanya Tucker."

podcast.title: Las Vegas Residency Trend
podcast.body: Shania Twain joined the growing number of pop stars who established Las Vegas residencies, a trend initiated by artists like Celine Dion and Britney Spears. These residencies allowed popular artists to perform to dedicated fan bases in a fixed location, contributing to Las Vegas's evolution as a diverse entertainment destination. "That led to Lady Gaga, Prince, the Backstreet Boys, Mariah Carey, Cher, Shania Twain, Bruno Mars, Adele, and dozens and dozens more."

xref.title: Early Performances and Breakthrough Opportunity
xref.body: She honed her performance skills at karaoke venues and county fairs, eventually winning a radio contest. The grand prize was an opportunity to sing with Shania Twain in front of 20,000 people when Twain performed in Ottawa. "From there was on to karaoke venues, singing at county fairs, and eventually winning a radio contest. The prize was a chance to sing in front of 20,000 people with Shania Twain when she played Ottawa."

xref.title: Large Bluegrass Ensemble
xref.body: Winston Marshall's Bluegrass group featured up to 16 members. They performed covers of artists ranging from The Grateful Dead, Neil Young, and Dexys Midnight Runners to Shania Twain, and played at a small 40-person bar in London called The Bosens Locker. "His sort of Bluegrass group was called Captain Kick and the Cowboy Ramblers, and it had up to 16 members."
